name: Visitor's Visa / visa-free entry

requirements.blocker_text: Many nationalities enter visa-free for up to 90 days; other nationalities need a consular Visitor's Visa issued under the Immigration Act 13 of 2002.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Visitor's Visa at a South African embassy or consulate if not visa-exempt.

requirements.blocker_text: Covers tourism, business meetings, and medical visits; does not authorise employment.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the relevant work or long-stay route instead if employment is intended.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid at least 30 days beyond intended departure, with 2 blank pages
Proof of onward/return travel and sufficient funds

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days, extendable at a Department of Home Affairs office

sources.title: Legitimus -- Temporary Residence Visa South Africa 2026 Guide, describing the Visitor's Visa category alongside other temporary residence visas
